onboarding.git.title: Git is required
onboarding.git.lead_missing: Session Relay uses Git to move your data to GitHub, but Git is not installed on this machine.
onboarding.git.lead_old: Session Relay needs Git 2.35 or newer. This machine has: {version}.
onboarding.config.title: This build has no GitHub App configured
onboarding.config.lead: Set SR_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and SR_GITHUB_APP_SLUG in .env (see .env.example) and rebuild.
onboarding.login.title: Sign in to GitHub
onboarding.login.lead: Session Relay only gets access to your storage repository, nothing else.
onboarding.login.waiting: Waiting for you to approve on GitHub…
onboarding.login.expired: The code expired. Get a new one to try again.
onboarding.login.denied: You declined on GitHub. Get a new code to try again.
onboarding.login.not_logged_in: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
onboarding.login.auth_rejected: GitHub no longer accepts the old session. Please sign in again.
onboarding.storage.title: Set up storage
onboarding.storage.no_installation: Your data is encrypted and stored in a private repository of your own. Do these two steps once per account.
onboarding.storage.repo_missing: Repository {name} is not among the repositories Session Relay can access.
onboarding.storage.repo_public: Repository {owner}/{name} is public. Make it private, then check again.
onboarding.storage.repo_foreign: Repository {owner}/{name} already has other content. Use an empty repository.
onboarding.storage.step_create: Create a private repository named {name}, empty (no README).
onboarding.storage.step_install: Install Session Relay and select only repository {name}.
onboarding.passphrase.create_lead: The passphrase encrypts every Claude session before it leaves this machine. Other machines need it to open them.
onboarding.passphrase.unlock_lead: Storage {owner}/{name} already has a key. Enter the passphrase you set on your first machine.
onboarding.passphrase.hint: Use 4–5 random words: easy to remember, hard to guess.
onboarding.passphrase.mismatch: The two entries do not match.
onboarding.passphrase.ack: I understand: losing the passphrase means losing all data. Nobody can recover it.
onboarding.passphrase.key_exists: Another machine created the key first. Unlock it with that machine's passphrase.
onboarding.machine.title: This machine
onboarding.machine.lead: The machine name appears in save history. Workspace folders help find your repositories on a new machine.
errors.network: Cannot reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
errors.auth_rejected: GitHub rejected the session. Please sign in again.
errors.not_logged_in: You are not signed in to GitHub.
errors.secrets: Cannot read or write Windows Credential Manager.
errors.weak_passphrase: The passphrase is too weak. Make it longer or add words.
errors.wrong_identity: This key does not belong to the storage in use.
errors.store_reset: The storage repository was emptied. Set up this machine again.
errors.key_exists: The storage already has a key.
errors.git_failed: Git failed while working with the storage.
errors.git_timeout: Git took too long. Check your connection and try again.
errors.busy: Another sync is running. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_client_id: This build has no GitHub App configured.
errors.not_linked: This project is not linked on this machine.
errors.rollback_detected: The cloud copy is older than one this machine already saw. Nothing was changed; check the storage repository.
errors.manifest_tampered: The storage data failed its integrity check.
errors.lease_rejected: Another machine saved at the same moment. Try again.
errors.io: Cannot read or write a local file.
status.remote_ahead_by: The cloud is newer · saved from {machine} {time}
status.diverged_hint: Use ⋯ to keep this machine's copy or the cloud's. The other side is backed up first.
project.force_local: Overwrite the cloud with this machine
project.force_remote: Overwrite this machine with the cloud
confirm.force_local_body: The cloud gets this machine's version of every changed file. The old cloud copies are backed up, encrypted, on this machine.
confirm.force_remote_body: This machine gets the cloud's version of every changed file. Local copies are backed up, encrypted, first.
confirm.delete_body: “{title}” is removed from the cloud for every machine. The copy on this machine stays.
sessions.title: Sessions
activity.title: Activity
activity.delete_remote: deleted a session from the cloud
sidebar.empty: No Claude sessions with a GitHub remote yet.
dashboard.empty: No Claude sessions with a GitHub remote yet. Folders without one: {unmanaged}.
link.mismatch_body: Its origin is {found}, not {remote}. Link it anyway?
link.no_repo_body: This folder is not a Git checkout of {remote}. Link it anyway?
skip.session_open: close the open Claude session, then try again
skip.backup_failed: could not back up the local copy
settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_save: Save automatically after each Claude reply
settings.auto_save_hint: Adds a hook to Claude's settings.json; turning it off removes it. The session is saved about 2 minutes after the last reply.
settings.auto_save_malformed: Claude's settings.json cannot be read or is not valid JSON, so auto-save cannot be turned on.
settings.cleanup_note: Claude deletes sessions older than cleanupPeriodDays (30 days by default). Saved copies stay in the cloud.
settings.clear_body: Removes this machine's copy of the storage, its sync state and backups. Claude's own files and the cloud stay; the next check downloads the storage again.
